title: Certified Residual Quasi-Newton Methods for Distributed Variational Inequalities
summary: Second-order methods for smooth monotone variational inequalities reach the optimal rate $O(T^{-3/2})$, but a distributed exact Jacobian costs $d$ times more communication than an operator value. We show that similarity does part of the work for free: if the server's Jacobian differs from the global one by at most $β$, using it gives $O(L_1D^3T^{-3/2}+βD^2T^{-1})$ at first-order communication cost.
